pages.text: Every machine, module and frame runs on a circuit. Each tier has its own, and each one is made from the circuit before it.$(br)$(li)$(item)Basic Circuit$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Advanced Circuit$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Elite Circuit$()

$(li)$(l)Basic Circuit$(): 1, Crafting table or Fabricator, Copper, redstone, gold nugget$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Circuit$(): 2, Fabricator only, 2 Basic Circuits, gold ingot, $(l)Acid$()$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Circuit$(): 3, Fabricator only, Advanced Circuit, diamond, uranium ingot, $(l)Acid$()
pages.title: The three circuits

pages.text: Your first $(l)Basic Circuits$() come from a crafting table: 2 Copper Ingots, 2 Redstone and 1 Gold Nugget make $(l)one$() circuit. It is slow and costly on purpose: build a $(l:materials/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l) as soon as you can. It makes $(l)two$() Basic Circuits from 1 Copper Ingot, 2 Redstone and 1 Gold Nugget.
pages.title: By hand

pages.text: The Advanced and Elite Circuits are etched with $(l)Acid$() in the $(l:materials/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l), which lists every recipe with its time.$(br)$(li)The Acid comes from an $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l), made from Nether sulfur.$(br)$(li)The uranium comes from $(l:nuclear/uranium)uranium ore$(/l).
pages.title: In the Fabricator
